sample_check.specifications_field: {} (empty) on all 5 — confirms these rows never had a PDP visit

identity_key_builder_code_reading.finding: normalize() is 100% title-text regex extraction (nameAr + nameEn only) — it has no parameter and no code path that reads a specifications object, description, or feature bullets. Even if a PDP re-scrape populated specifications, current code would not consume it without a separate extension.
identity_key_builder_code_reading.confidence_rule: identity.ts requires series_or_platform AND technology (non-inferred) AND cooling_mode all to be genuinely stated for 'valid' tier (ADR-079, ADR-306) — brand and capacity_btu are the only hard requirements. This design is deliberate and evidence-based (both ADRs cite measured false-negative rates from requiring these fields), not a bug.

empirical_amazon_sa_live_page_tests.product: Fisher Window Air Conditioner Cold 18000 Btu - FWAC-H18CF

found_on_page.brand: فيشر / Fisher — present, matches captured data
found_on_page.item_model_number: FWAC-H18CF — real, NOT currently captured by Tawveeri (stored model='18000', the BTU number)
found_on_page.cooling_mode_evidence: description explicitly states 'بارد فقط' (cool only); English title contains 'Cold' with no 'hot'/'heat' — already correctly extracted as cool_only
found_on_page.series_or_platform: NOT FOUND anywhere on the page (title, bullets, spec table, description)
found_on_page.technology_inverter_status: NOT FOUND anywhere on the page — no 'إنفرتر'/'Inverter'/'on-off' statement at all
found_on_page.gtin_ean_upc: NOT FOUND — Product Details table has no such field visible

empirical_amazon_sa_live_page_tests.conclusion: For THIS product, low_confidence status is CORRECT and evidence-complete — the missing fields (series, technology) are genuinely absent from Amazon's own listing at every level, not a Tawveeri capture gap. Re-scraping the PDP would NOT promote this one to valid.

empirical_amazon_sa_live_page_tests.product_as_stored_by_tawveeri: 18000BTU Fast Cooling Split Air Conditioner, White (brand recorded as 'unknown')
empirical_amazon_sa_live_page_tests.product_as_shown_on_amazon: مكيف سبليت للتبريد السريع 18000 وحدة حرارية بريطانية من كرافت، لون أبيض

found_on_page.brand: كرافت / Kraft — CLEARLY STATED, both in the byline and the Product Details table. Tawveeri's captured data has brand='unknown' for this SKU.
found_on_page.manufacturer: Al Obaidi General General Trading (Product Details table)
found_on_page.form_factor: نظام سبليت (Split system) — confirms type=split, already correctly captured
found_on_page.technology_inverter_status: NOT FOUND anywhere on the page

empirical_amazon_sa_live_page_tests.conclusion: For THIS product, Tawveeri's captured title/brand data is genuinely incomplete relative to what Amazon actually shows — a real brand ('Kraft') exists and was missed. This IS a recoverable gap. But even with the brand recovered, series/technology would still be unstated at the source (same limitation as case 1) — so this would move from 'unknown|split|...' toward 'kraft|split|...', still low_confidence, not valid, without also solving the series/technology question.

conclusion_root_cause: MULTIPLE CAUSES (hypothesis I), confirmed by direct empirical testing, not assumed: (1) genuine source-data sparsity for series/technology on budget/generic-brand AC units — present in both tested cases and appears to be the harder, less-recoverable half; (2) real brand-capture misses on the search-tile-only discovery path for a subset of listings — recoverable via PDP re-scrape, present in 1 of 2 tested cases. Sample size is 2, not the mission's requested 20-30 — an honest limitation, time-bounded. Percentages/counts of the 147 falling into each bucket are UNKNOWN without a larger sample or an actual re-scrape-and-remeasure experiment.
